name: The fall of the Betrayer

date.label: Burning Crusade quest chronology; exact in-world dating unknown

summary: At last, Akama and the adventurers face Illidan atop the Black Temple. The Betrayer’s fall ends the Burning Crusade quest that carried the seeker from Baa’ri through the raids and into the fortress. Akama has reclaimed his soul, and the Ashtongue have risen from Illidan’s control. The tale leaves Karabor’s later fate and Akama’s rule unspoken.
